programs.description: An only child, Bhoomi longs for the warmth of a joint family. However, after her dream comes true, she faces difficult challenges to win over the hearts of her husband's relatives.
Bhairavi has a loving mother but an evil father. However, despite her affectionate nature, she faces betrayal from the family.
Camaraderie sours as Lalitha and Annapurna vie for Shivaramaraju's affection, both marrying him. Subsequently, a birthing mishap compels him to clandestinely part Annapurna's twins.
Neelaveni's life changes when she marries Tarak and finds herself stuck between her husband and her mother-in-law's troubles.
The host invites contestants to the stage to share their stories and compete in various entertaining games to win prizes.
